7
(1) Every member of the Corporation who possess the

column1: qualifications specified in the rules to be made under section
7  of  this  Act,  shall  be  entitled  to  take  and  use  the  title
“Chartered Quantity Surveyor”.

column2: (2) Every member of the Corporation, who is registered

column1: as a Fellow Member shall be entitled to use the abbreviated
designation “F.I.Q.S.SL” after his name.

column2: (3) Every member of the Corporation who is registered as

column1: an Associate Member of the Corporation shall be entitled to
use the abbreviated designation “A.I.Q.S.SL” after his name.

column2: (4) Where majority of the partners or directors of a firm or

column1: Company  of  Quantity  Surveyors  who  possess
qualifications to be specified in the rules to be made under
section 7 of this Act, are members of the Corporation, such
firm or Company may be permitted by the Council to use the
title “Chartered Quantity Surveyor” or “Chartered Quantity
Surveyors” as the case may be, upon a request made in that
behalf by such firm or company to the Council.

column2: The Council may appoint Attorneys-at-law, Bankers

column1: of the Corporation, any agent or such other persons as may be
required for the purposes of the Corporation and may rescind
such appointments  at any time.

column2: The Seal of the Corporation shall not be affixed to

column1: any  instrument  whatsoever  except  in  the  presence  of  the
Secretary  or  a  member  of  the  Council  who  may  be  duly
authorised by the Council and another member of the Council
who shall sign their names on the instrument in token of their
presence and such signing shall be independent of the signing
of any person as a witness.

column2: No  Member  of  the  Corporation  shall,  for  the

column1: purpose  of  discharging  the  debts  and  liabilities  of  the
Corporation,  or  for  any  other  purpose,  be  liable  to  make
any  contribution  exceeding
subscription payable by him to the Corporation.
